decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line is strongly visible with its own page across two years, fits the firm's natural facial-care core, and is likely a stable part of the assortment.

The hyaluronic acid serum matches current skincare demand and the firm's offer, but its lower website prominence suggests it is somewhat easier to discontinue than a lead line if sales are only average.
The facial cleansing oil is a very recent launch in a close category, so uncertainty is higher, but as a natural-care extension it is still worth keeping on the market for a further test period.
